meta.title: Communications
meta.description: It's not known where the signal came from, nor where it's headed.

units.rawText: Somewhere in Magrasea, in what appears to be a Null Area.
units.displayText: Somewhere in Magrasea, in what appears to be a Null Area.

spans.text: Somewhere in Magrasea, in what appears to be a Null Area.

units.rawText: A black goat is jumping around here. A signal comes from parts unknown, and its destination is equally mysterious.
units.displayText: A black goat is jumping around here. A signal comes from parts unknown, and its destination is equally mysterious.

spans.text: A black goat is jumping around here. A signal comes from parts unknown, and its destination is equally mysterious.

units.rawText: Oh? You hardly ever contact me at times like this.
units.displayText: Oh? You hardly ever contact me at times like this.

spans.text: Oh? You hardly ever contact me at times like this.

units.rawText: Did you miss me after not seeing me for so long?
units.displayText: Did you miss me after not seeing me for so long?

spans.text: Did you miss me after not seeing me for so long?

units.rawText: What did you make Odile do in the Copley Sector?
units.displayText: What did you make Odile do in the Copley Sector?

spans.text: What did you make Odile do in the Copley Sector?

units.rawText: Odile of the Pierides Sector? You didn't say anything when I took her in, so why are you asking about that now?
units.displayText: Odile of the Pierides Sector? You didn't say anything when I took her in, so why are you asking about that now?

spans.text: Odile of the Pierides Sector? You didn't say anything when I took her in, so why are you asking about that now?

units.rawText: She caused a big furore in the Copley Sector and ended up attracting the attention of the Reverse Tower.
units.displayText: She caused a big furore in the Copley Sector and ended up attracting the attention of the Reverse Tower.

spans.text: She caused a big furore in the Copley Sector and ended up attracting the attention of the Reverse Tower.

units.rawText: Don't you think you're overstepping your bounds a little, <color=purple>Malkira?</color>
units.displayText: Don't you think you're overstepping your bounds a little, Malkira?

spans.text: Don't you think you're overstepping your bounds a little,
Malkira?

units.rawText: You haven't called me that in a long time... Honestly, are you that mad?
units.displayText: You haven't called me that in a long time... Honestly, are you that mad?

spans.text: You haven't called me that in a long time... Honestly, are you that mad?

units.rawText: Let me guess, you're mad because you're afraid you can't handle the Reverse Tower, am I right?
units.displayText: Let me guess, you're mad because you're afraid you can't handle the Reverse Tower, am I right?

spans.text: Let me guess, you're mad because you're afraid you can't handle the Reverse Tower, am I right?

units.rawText: You'd better answer my question first.
units.displayText: You'd better answer my question first.

spans.text: You'd better answer my question first.

units.rawText: Alright. Odile had a mission.
units.displayText: Alright. Odile had a mission.

spans.text: Alright. Odile had a mission.

units.rawText: I sent her there to help me confirm... If there were those of my kind in Magrasea who I'm unfamiliar with.
units.displayText: I sent her there to help me confirm... If there were those of my kind in Magrasea who I'm unfamiliar with.

spans.text: I sent her there to help me confirm... If there were those of my kind in Magrasea who I'm unfamiliar with.

units.rawText: All the Entropics are under your control. You should know the situation in Magrasea well.
units.displayText: All the Entropics are under your control. You should know the situation in Magrasea well.

spans.text: All the Entropics are under your control. You should know the situation in Magrasea well.

units.rawText: But I sense them all the time. The signal of unfamiliar kin, as well as Low-Order individuals that I couldn't control...
units.displayText: But I sense them all the time. The signal of unfamiliar kin, as well as Low-Order individuals that I couldn't control...

spans.text: But I sense them all the time. The signal of unfamiliar kin, as well as Low-Order individuals that I couldn't control...

units.rawText: I was so surprised at first! Because if I can't control them, there must be another "Arbiter" with the same authority as me.
units.displayText: I was so surprised at first! Because if I can't control them, there must be another "Arbiter" with the same authority as me.

spans.text: I was so surprised at first! Because if I can't control them, there must be another "Arbiter" with the same authority as me.

units.rawText: Tell me, what on earth is that all about? Who, in all of Magrasea... would be authorized to carry out such research?
units.displayText: Tell me, what on earth is that all about? Who, in all of Magrasea... would be authorized to carry out such research?

spans.text: Tell me, what on earth is that all about? Who, in all of Magrasea... would be authorized to carry out such research?

units.rawText: You think I did it?
units.displayText: You think I did it?

spans.text: You think I did it?

units.rawText: How could I? We share a strong and respectful partnership, after all.
units.displayText: How could I? We share a strong and respectful partnership, after all.

spans.text: How could I? We share a strong and respectful partnership, after all.

units.rawText: I trust you, and you trust me, right? You've never thought of secretly raising something to supplant me, I hope?
units.displayText: I trust you, and you trust me, right? You've never thought of secretly raising something to supplant me, I hope?

spans.text: I trust you, and you trust me, right? You've never thought of secretly raising something to supplant me, I hope?

units.rawText: Of course. What you found was nothing more than an experimental subject reared by a Sector Administrator who walked a false path.
units.displayText: Of course. What you found was nothing more than an experimental subject reared by a Sector Administrator who walked a false path.

spans.text: Of course. What you found was nothing more than an experimental subject reared by a Sector Administrator who walked a false path.

units.rawText: Hehe... I'll take your word for it. But still, our system has determined that we can only have one "Arbiter."
units.displayText: Hehe... I'll take your word for it. But still, our system has determined that we can only have one "Arbiter."

spans.text: Hehe... I'll take your word for it. But still, our system has determined that we can only have one "Arbiter."

units.rawText: So you sent Odile there to make a big fuss? Using the Exiles and the Sanctifiers to clean up after you?
units.displayText: So you sent Odile there to make a big fuss? Using the Exiles and the Sanctifiers to clean up after you?

spans.text: So you sent Odile there to make a big fuss? Using the Exiles and the Sanctifiers to clean up after you?

units.rawText: What's wrong with that? They were cleaning up after you too.
units.displayText: What's wrong with that? They were cleaning up after you too.

spans.text: What's wrong with that? They were cleaning up after you too.

units.rawText: If we let that little "Arbiter" continue to grow unchecked until she went on a rampage all over Magrasea one day... You would be in trouble too.
units.displayText: If we let that little "Arbiter" continue to grow unchecked until she went on a rampage all over Magrasea one day... You would be in trouble too.

spans.text: If we let that little "Arbiter" continue to grow unchecked until she went on a rampage all over Magrasea one day... You would be in trouble too.

units.rawText: I was solving a problem for you. After all, you went to great lengths to get off your high horse and work with me.
units.displayText: I was solving a problem for you. After all, you went to great lengths to get off your high horse and work with me.

spans.text: I was solving a problem for you. After all, you went to great lengths to get off your high horse and work with me.

units.rawText: Since chances like these don't come by often, I wanted to do my best to help you out too~
units.displayText: Since chances like these don't come by often, I wanted to do my best to help you out too~

spans.text: Since chances like these don't come by often, I wanted to do my best to help you out too~

units.rawText: ...Hehe. Thank you very much, then.
units.displayText: ...Hehe. Thank you very much, then.

spans.text: ...Hehe. Thank you very much, then.

units.rawText: I will repay your kindness. Someday.
units.displayText: I will repay your kindness. Someday.

spans.text: I will repay your kindness. Someday.

units.rawText: I'll be looking forward to it, then. Will you keep contacting me frequently?
units.displayText: I'll be looking forward to it, then. Will you keep contacting me frequently?

spans.text: I'll be looking forward to it, then. Will you keep contacting me frequently?

units.rawText:
The other party does not answer.
The transmission ends, and the jumping black goat stops moving.
units.displayText:
The other party does not answer.
The transmission ends, and the jumping black goat stops moving.

spans.text:
The other party does not answer.
The transmission ends, and the jumping black goat stops moving.

units.rawText: Silence falls once again on what appears to be a Null Area.
units.displayText: Silence falls once again on what appears to be a Null Area.

spans.text: Silence falls once again on what appears to be a Null Area.
